name: Tender Veal Scallopini al Limone with Creamy Mashed Potatoes
whyItWorks: Tender veal cutlets lightly pounded thin and gently sauteed in white wine and a delicate squeeze of lemon. Veal is exceptionally tender and easy on the stomach compared to tough beef cuts.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask for light lemon reduction and smooth peeled mashed potatoes as the side. Skip capers if seeds cause irritation.
